name: NLWeb
summary: Open protocols and reference implementation for natural-language interfaces to websites, using Schema.org/RSS and natively supporting MCP.
description: Originally published by Microsoft (microsoft/NLWeb, now redirecting to nlweb-ai/NLWeb). The NLWeb protocol spec (v0.55) is published as NLWEBSPEC.md in nlweb-ai/website; nlweb.ai itself currently fails TLS (it serves a *.github.io certificate), so link the GitHub copy. REST API docs: docs/nlweb-rest-api.md in the main repo.
